stem.text: Three test-tubes, X, Y, and Z, each contain a small amount of water.

items: A small amount of $\text{NaCl}$ is added to test-tube X.
A small amount of $\text{SiCl}_4$ is added to test-tube Y.
A small amount of $\text{AlCl}_3$ is added to test-tube Z.

stem.text: After a short time, two drops of Universal Indicator solution are added to each test-tube.

items: The indicator added to test-tube X stays green.
The indicator added to test-tube Y turns red.
The indicator added to test-tube Z turns red.
